card.name: Early pieces of brand names
card.fires_on: Responds to the first or second piece of a split-up brand name written in capitals, such as COPIKTRA, QINLOCK, OCREVUS or ZEPZELCA. It also fires on the first katakana パ in quoted Japanese game names.

modes.label: Brand name pieces
modes.description: An early piece inside a drug brand name, often in capitals, before the name is complete.

modes.label: Japanese katakana start
modes.description: The first katakana character of a quoted Japanese name such as パックマン.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward continuing with the next piece of a foreign or unusual name, mostly Japanese katakana pieces.
card.plain: It fires partway through an unfamiliar drug brand name, before the name is finished.
